crossRefs.note: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about…
But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought…
And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to…
My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

parallels.note: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

translations.web: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.
translations.bsb: About five thousand men were fed, besides women and children.
translations.kjv: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
translations.asv: And they that did eat were about five thousand men, besides women and children.
